exam.title: Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite is published; Salesforce recommends at least six months of platform administration. Practice company/user/security configuration, data modeling and Lightning pages, sales/service/collaboration, controlled data and analytics, bulk-safe automation, and foundational Agentforce administration in an authorized disposable org.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder (15%)

review.notes: All eight current weighted domains are mapped through configuration, least privilege, data model/UI, sales/service/collaboration, data and analytics, bulk-safe automation, and bounded Agentforce operations. Three integrated scenarios, eight authorized labs and 40 original checks are included. The December 2025 refresh and stale Summer '25 Help label are explicit. No recalled/live item, dump, shared superbadge solution or copied course content is used.

findings.title: Help release label remains inconsistent with the scope refresh
findings.evidence: English body through locale fallback includes Agentforce8% and Summer25 version label; Academy booking details unreadable.
findings.recommendation: Keep the support limitation visible pending authoritative evidence.

findings.title: Announcement publication is later than blueprint effective date
findings.evidence: January22,2026 article dates the eight-domain update to December15,2025.
findings.recommendation: Keep publication and effective dates separate; Administrator Agentforce remains foundational.
findings.resolution: Keep publication and effective dates separate; Administrator Agentforce remains foundational.

findings.title: A group mute is not a global deny
findings.evidence: Profile,direct permission set and other groups can still grant a muted permission; dependencies also matter.
findings.recommendation: Teach complete grant tracing and original bounded permission arithmetic.
findings.resolution: Teach complete grant tracing and original bounded permission arithmetic.

findings.title: A fault path can preserve partial work
findings.evidence: Handled faults do not automatically roll back earlier record changes; screen and record-triggered flows have distinct rollback elements.
findings.recommendation: Teach current-transaction boundaries and separate notification from recovery.
findings.resolution: Teach current-transaction boundaries and separate notification from recovery.

findings.title: Enforcing user permissions is a versioned run option
findings.evidence: API68+ new option prevents caller elevation for eligible flow types,without changing running-user identity.
findings.recommendation: Mark version and org availability for verification; distinguish the actual user from a verified customer.
findings.resolution: Mark version and org availability for verification; distinguish the actual user from a verified customer.

findings.title: Verified contact identity does not automatically scope agent access
findings.evidence: Identified contact conversations can still run as agent user; context variables alone do not control record access.
findings.recommendation: Require trusted customer scoping as well as record permissions; distinguish supported authenticated-site route.
findings.resolution: Require trusted customer scoping as well as record permissions; distinguish supported authenticated-site route.

findings.title: Transport success can contain individual data failures
findings.evidence: Collections HTTP200 may contain errors; allOrNone defaults false and ordered per-item results require inspection.
findings.recommendation: Add original CSV/SQLite reconciliation and rollback receipt,explicitly not an API emulator.
findings.resolution: Add original CSV/SQLite reconciliation and rollback receipt,explicitly not an API emulator.
